\documentclass{article}
\newcommand\zero{body}
\newcommand\one[1]{#1}
\newcommand*\short[1]{#1}
\newcommand\opt[1][dflt]{(#1)}
\makeatletter
\typeout{PYFORMAT:zero=\meaning\zero}
\typeout{PYFORMAT:one=\meaning\one}
\typeout{PYFORMAT:short=\meaning\short}
\typeout{PYFORMAT:public=\meaning\opt}
\expandafter\let\expandafter\hidden\csname\string\opt\endcsname
\typeout{PYFORMAT:hidden=\meaning\hidden}
\newcommand\second[1][dflt]{(#1)}
\ifx\opt\second\typeout{PYFORMAT:same=yes}\else\typeout{PYFORMAT:same=no}\fi
\IfFileExists{witness.tex}{\typeout{PYFORMAT:present=yes}}{\typeout{PYFORMAT:present=no}}
\IfFileExists{missing-pytexml-witness.tex}{\def\Selected{yes}}{\def\Selected{no}}
\typeout{PYFORMAT:missing=\Selected}
\typeout{PYFORMAT:filefound=\meaning\@filef@und}
\typeout{PYFORMAT:current=\meaning\@curr@file}
\typeout{PYFORMAT:branch=\meaning\reserved@a}
\begin{document}OK\end{document}
